_note: Narrator rotation (Rob, 2026-11-22). Each episode gets the next voice: index = days since start_date (slot date, America/New_York) mod len(voices). Repeats every 21 days. A quoted myth/question line uses quote_voice: the next voice in the list of the opposite gender (prefix af/bf = female, am/bm = male). Excluded: am_santa (novelty), am_adam, af_jessica, am_echo, bf_alice, bf_lily, af_nicole (whispery, ~50% slower; swapped for af_river).
_slot_b: Two posts a day (2026-11-27): a spec with "slot": "B" uses index + slot_b_offset, so slot A and slot B of the same day never share a narrator (the same voice comes back as a slot A narrator 11 days later).
